title: Another site's requests are refused, whoever is signed in
steps: Use the app as usual: edit a note, open the calendar, install Word count from the Catalog. Everything the app's own page asks works as before.

From another site's console (any page), run fetch("<this Preview>/mcp", { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain" }, body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "write_file", arguments: { path: "From elsewhere.md", text: "x", base: 0 } } }) }). No note called From elsewhere appears here. (A no-cors request can only be a GET, HEAD or POST, which is why this goes through MCP.)
